name: – Nathalie Loiseau – § 4 – Am 17
title: REPORT on EU-Syria political relations
part_text: 4. Underlines that EU political engagement, financial assistance, reconstruction support, the suspension of sanctions or resumption of institutional cooperation should continue to be reversible, benchmark-based and strictly conditional on a genuine, pluralistic and inclusive Syrian-led political transition process, with measurable progress on the rule of law, constitutional reform, security-sector reform, return and readmission programmes, counterterrorism cooperation, humanitarian access, anti-corruption safeguards, the respect of international human rights standards, the protection of religious and ethnic minorities, transitional justice and accountability for serious crimes, as well as a commitment to peaceful neighbourly relations, regional cooperation and full compliance with Syria’s obligations under international law;
